## Summary

Demonstrate publishing and consuming ToneForge assets through a marketplace. Assets are procedural systems (recipes, stacks, sequences, palettes), not static audio files -- buyers get infinite variation from a single purchase.

## Prerequisite Demos

- Demo 12: Compiler & Validator -- Production-Ready Assets (TF-0MLXF9FWG18T2ZHD)
- Demo 15: Network & Integrations -- Distributed & Embedded (TF-0MLXFBHHW1BBO1ZJ)

## New Modules

Marketplace

## What the User Sees

- Browse marketplace listings: `toneforge marketplace search --category "sci-fi weapons"`
- Install packages: `toneforge marketplace install industrial_lasers@2.1.0`
- Use installed recipes immediately with local registry
- Publish own packages with validation: `toneforge marketplace publish --package ./my-recipes/ --name "organic_footsteps" --version 1.0.0`

## New CLI Commands

- `toneforge marketplace search --category <c>`
- `toneforge marketplace install <package>@<version>`
- `toneforge marketplace publish --package <dir> --name <n> --version <v>`

## Key Proof Points

- Marketplace assets are procedural systems, not static files -- infinite variation from a single package
- Validator gates publishing -- no broken or invalid assets reach the marketplace
- Semantic versioning ensures compatibility
- Installed recipes integrate seamlessly with the local registry

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Search returns relevant packages with metadata (recipes, stacks, ratings, license)
2. Install adds recipes to the local registry and they work immediately
3. Publish validates the package before uploading
4. Installed packages maintain determinism (same seed = same output)
5. Version conflicts are detected and reported

## Reference PRDs

MARKETPLACE_PRD.md

data.description:
# Recipe Book Harness & Tracer Slice

> **Goal:** Provide the manifest-driven tooling and test battery that makes the 100-recipe book
> mechanically verifiable, and prove the whole pipeline end-to-end with one real recipe + page
> (a tracer bullet through every layer: recipe data, generator, docs, index, tests).

## Context

The book must not be able to drift from the code (AC 5). This feature builds the *machinery*
before any bulk authoring: a single roster manifest that declares all 100 planned recipes
(so later tiers only add entries), a page template, generators for the index and the
ToneForge CLI command blocks, and a test battery run against every *delivered* roster entry.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `src/recipes/recipe-book/roster.ts` type-checks and declares all 100 planned recipes with `name`, `tier`, `family` and a one-line sound-design intent; tier counts are 14/14/16/14/14/14/14 = 100.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` and `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` run via `tsx`, are idempotent (second run produces byte-identical output), and fail loudly on a delivery gap.
- `docs/recipe-book/_template.md` defines the page shape: front matter (`title`, `id`, `order`, `description`), a hand-authored `## Sound design` section, and a `## ToneForge CLI` section whose command block sits between machine-readable markers.
- `src/recipes/__tests__/recipe-book.test.ts` asserts, for every delivered roster entry: ToneGraph schema validity; byte-identical determinism at a fixed seed; non-silence; a matching `docs/recipe-book/<name>.md` page; presence in `docs/recipe-book/index.md` in roster order; required tags (`casual` plus at least one of `fun`/`joy`, plus a family tag); and CLI-block freshness (regeneration matches the committed block).
- The tracer recipe `presets/recipes/blip-sine-ping.yaml` and page `docs/recipe-book/blip-sine-ping.md` are delivered and pass every gate above.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` is generated from delivered entries in roster order; the full project suite passes (`npm test`).


Parent acceptance-criteria traceability:
- Traces to parent AC 2: **Monotonic complexity progression** across the defined tiers (see Scope): the set starts at single-oscillator primitives and ends at self-contained 2–3 voice melodic stings, with each tier illustrating the tooling stage appropriate to it (Q6/A).
- Traces to parent AC 3: **Every recipe has a matching page** under `docs/recipe-book/` containing both a **Sound design** section (building blocks, parameters/ranges, seed behaviour, musical intent) and a **ToneForge CLI** section (copy-paste commands relevant to that recipe), and `docs/recipe-book/index.md` lists all 100 in ascending complexity order.
- Traces to parent AC 5: **Automated tests** validate: ToneGraph schema validity; deterministic rendering (same seed ⇒ byte-identical output); non-silence; recipe ↔ page bidirectional coverage (every recipe documented, every page backed by a recipe); and index completeness.
## Minimal Implementation

- Author the roster manifest with all 100 names/tiers/families/intents (roster is fixed in the parent plan).
- Author the page template and the two generator scripts (reuse `gray-matter` for front matter).
- Author the test battery; scope coverage assertions to roster entries that are delivered so
  every later tier stays green, with the "all 100 delivered" gate deferred to the completion feature.
- Author the tracer recipe + page and regenerate the index.

## Key Files

- `src/recipes/recipe-book/roster.ts` — canonical 100-entry roster manifest (new).
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — index generator (new).
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — CLI-block generator/validator (new).
- `docs/recipe-book/_template.md` — page template (new).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` — generated ordered index (new).
- `src/recipes/__tests__/recipe-book.test.ts` — coverage/determinism/tag/CLI-freshness battery (new).
- `presets/recipes/blip-sine-ping.yaml` — tracer recipe (new).
- `docs/recipe-book/blip-sine-ping.md` — tracer page (new).

## Dependencies

None — this is the first feature and unblocks all tiers.

## Deliverables

Roster manifest; two generator scripts; page template; generated index; test battery;
one complete tracer recipe + page.
